message.content: {"caption":"Line chart comparing model accuracy across five tolerance levels for five training-data splits.","description":"A five-series line chart titled “OfficeQA: Model Accuracy vs Tolerance.” The horizontal axis is Tolerance (%) with categories, from left to right, 10%, 5%, 1%, 0.1%, and 0.00%; the vertical axis is Accuracy (%) with ticks at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. The legend identifies base (pink), 5% (olive), 10% (green), 15% (blue), and merge-unique-skills (purple). Each series has a circular marker at every tolerance. Accuracy decreases as the plotted tolerance moves from 10% toward 0.00% for every series. The purple merge-unique-skills line is generally highest: it is very close to the green 10% line at 10% and 5%, then leads at the stricter levels, ending around 68%. The pink base line is lowest throughout, ending near 61%. At 0.1%, the green and blue markers nearly coincide around 70%; at 5%, the green and purple markers also nearly coincide around 80%. Chart values are estimated from the plotted marks, not printed point
